gpu.unsaveable.venus.message: The guest is using Vulkan, whose state can't be saved yet.
gpu.unsaveable.venus.note: Why a snapshot can't be taken, shown in the message bar (under the toolbar) as the detail under “The machine can't be saved.” (Snapshot, Save snapshot or Suspend while the machine runs): a program in the guest uses Vulkan (Venus), whose state snapshots don't hold yet.

gpu.unsaveable.virgl.message: The guest is using 3D graphics, and their state can't be saved with the renderer in use.
gpu.unsaveable.virgl.note: Why a snapshot can't be taken, shown in the message bar (under the toolbar) as the detail under “The machine can't be saved.” (Snapshot, Save snapshot or Suspend while the machine runs): a program in the guest uses 3D (virgl), and the renderer drawing it can't save its state.

gpu-worker.unreadable3d.message: The 3D graphics' state couldn't be read.
gpu-worker.unreadable3d.note: Why a snapshot can't be taken, shown in the message bar (under the toolbar) as the detail under “The machine can't be saved.” (Snapshot, Save snapshot or Suspend while the machine runs): reading back the 3D renderer's state failed; the renderer's error follows it as a further detail.

virgl-renderer.unsaveable.video.message: The guest is decoding a video through the GPU, which can't be saved. Close the video player first.
virgl-renderer.unsaveable.video.note: Why a snapshot can't be taken, shown in the message bar (under the toolbar) as the detail under “The machine can't be saved.” (Snapshot, Save snapshot or Suspend while the machine runs): the guest is decoding a video through the browser's decoders, whose pictures can't be saved.

main.webglLost.message: The browser lost the screen's WebGL context
main.webglLost.note: Error headline in the message bar (under the toolbar) when the browser took away the 3D screen's WebGL context (the machine has crashed; Show serial log and the like follow).

main.gpuWorkerFailed.note: Error headline in the message bar (under the toolbar) when the worker that draws a 3D machine's screen failed (the machine has crashed); the browser's error is the detail under it.
